data.name: Medieval Lord Tycoon
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Medieval Lord Tycoon is a charming pixel-art medieval lord simulator that puts you in the crown of a rising ruler, tasking you with building, managing, and defending a thriving medieval domain. Blending hands-on craftsmanship with strategic governance, it offers a flexible and immersive take on feudal leadership—where every choice shapes the fate of your lands and people.

Core Gameplay

Step into the boots of a lord with dual paths to prosperity: roll up your sleeves for hands-on labor, or rule with shrewd delegation. Till fertile fields, swing an axe to chop timber, and track game in the forests to secure resources firsthand—savoring the gritty charm of medieval self-sufficiency. Or, optimize efficiency by assigning these trivial daily tasks to your townsfolk, freeing you to focus on the grander work of growing your realm.

Crucially, you won’t micromanage your people’s daily lives—but your authority guides their success. Regulate your domain through tailored taxes (balancing treasury health with public morale), enforce laws to maintain order, and roll out policies that align with your vision—whether prioritizing agriculture, trade, or defense. Every decision ripples through your settlement: fair governance boosts loyalty, while missteps may sow discontent.

When raiders or rival lords threaten your lands, your prestige becomes your greatest weapon. The higher your standing among the people, the more peasants will rally to your banner, taking up arms to defend their homes and your rule. Lead them to victory, and your legend as a wise and formidable lord will grow—securing your domain’s place in medieval history.

Key Features

  • Dual Play Styles: Choose between hands-on labor (farming, chopping, hunting) or efficient delegation to townsfolk—play how you want to rule.

  • Strategic Governance: Shape your realm through taxes, laws, and policies—no direct control over daily lives, but total influence over long-term prosperity.

  • Prestige & Defense System: Build your reputation to rally more defenders during attacks; the loyalty of your people is your strongest fortress.

  • Charming Pixel-Art Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a nostalgic, visually cohesive medieval world brought to life with detailed pixel graphics and atmospheric design.

  • Dynamic Realm Growth: Watch your humble village evolve into a bustling town (and beyond) as you master resource management, governance, and defense.

What You’ll Experience

From the first plow in the soil to the clash of swords against invaders, Medieval Lord Tycoon lets you live out the fantasy of ruling a medieval domain on your terms. Whether you prefer getting your hands dirty with manual labor or orchestrating grand strategies from the castle walls, the game adapts to your leadership style. Balance short-term needs (securing food, wood, and game) with long-term goals (building prestige, uniting your people, and repelling threats) to create a legacy that endures. With its blend of accessibility and depth, it’s perfect for both casual players drawn to pixel-art charm and strategy enthusiasts craving meaningful decision-making.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 (32/64-bit), macOS 10.13+, Ubuntu 18.04+
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated (Intel HD 4000) or dedicated (256 MB VRAM, Shader Model 3.0+/OpenGL 2.1+)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit), macOS 10.15+, Ubuntu 20.04+
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.4 GHz (Intel i3/AMD Ryzen 3 or equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated (512 MB VRAM, NVIDIA GTX 550 Ti/AMD HD 5770 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
